name: Active Lifestyle
overview: An active lifestyle, from a biblical perspective, involves responding to Christ’s love through obedience and compassionate engagement with others. Jesus’ encounter with the man born blind in John 9:1 illustrates the call to move beyond limitations and respond in faith. John 14:15 emphasizes that love for Christ is demonstrated by keeping His commandments, which requires intentional and active commitment. Additionally, Romans 14:1 encourages believers to support those weaker in faith with patience and grace, showing that an active Christian life includes building up others rather than engaging in divisive disputes.
